{labels.skip}
{labels.workspace} {labels.workspacePath}
{labels.demoWorkspace}

{labels.eyebrow}

{labels.workspaceTitle}

{labels.workspaceDescription}

{scenarios.map(({ icon: Icon, label, question, description }) => (

{label}

{description}

{question}
))}
{labels.layoutPrefix} {mode === "embedded" ? labels.embeddedLayout : labels.floatingLayout}

{labels.demoNote}

) } export default function AgentPage() { return ( ) }
